authority: Controller 0-C must separately dispatch/authorize any evaluator; no C worker launched

S2.hypothesis: Completed 4H/1D break of an already confirmed zone, later retest and completed-bar acceptance; separately frozen causal clocks and structural invalidation

S3.hypothesis: Meaningful completed 4H/1D failed break and later recovery/rejection; separately frozen causal failure/invalidation evidence

clock_rule: Use only immutable source facts available and durable by decision; pivots bind confirmation availability. Revisions version/cancel, never rewrite ex-ante decisions. Observation coverage starts after decision; initial partial-bar gap must be explicit.

cost_parameters.native_defaults: UNKNOWN; source/venue-specific evidence required. No favorable funding credit without admissible evidence.
cost_parameters.sensitivity: Predeclare base/adverse scenarios and delay at the scheduled 00/12 UTC reviews; 4–24h and 1–5d horizons. Freeze before outcome access; retain all scenarios, no best-case selection.
cost_parameters.synthetic_defaults: A1_FROZEN_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.json strategy.costs_bps, explicitly uncalibrated simulator assumptions

evaluation_design.clustering: Cluster overlapping episodes across BTC/ETH/SOL by common market shock and UTC time block; report independent cluster counts, not duplicated cost/delay rows
controls: randomized admissible entry-time control preserving clusters
evaluation_design.matched_null: Source-, symbol-, regime-, volatility-, timestamp-, cost-, review-delay-, holding-horizon- and censoring-matched no-edge/first-passage controls, with the same observation and entry model

minimum_gates.additional_power_gate: A prospective 80% power calculation for a predeclared practical effect and 95% uncertainty target must also pass; count floors alone do not establish adequate power

report: planned vs executable vs modeled after-cost R
MAE/MFE only with sufficient ordered evidence
evaluation_design.uncertainty: Predeclare cluster/bootstrap or valid dependence-aware intervals, censoring treatment, multiple-comparison correction and power/MDE plan; report effect and interval against matched controls
evaluation_design.unit: Immutable opportunity episode; parameter/cost/delay scenario rows from the same episode are NOT independent samples

outcome_taxonomy.AMBIGUOUS_OHLC_ORDER_UNKNOWN: Same unordered OHLC contains entry and exit or both barriers; do not choose a favorable ordering
outcome_taxonomy.INSUFFICIENT_FUTURE_HORIZON: Not enough later admissible evidence yet; never promote to success/failure
outcome_taxonomy.MISSED_ENTRY: Observed price left entry region without admissible entry condition; no chase or assumed fill
outcome_taxonomy.MISSING_COVERAGE: Missing/gapped/revised or otherwise inadmissible observation path; never impute neutral return
outcome_taxonomy.NO_FILL: No modeled entry condition before expiry in complete declared observation window; no actual fill assertion
outcome_taxonomy.RIGHT_CENSORED: Declared observation stop before a required horizon; retain in denominator with censoring method
outcome_taxonomy.STOP_FIRST: Stop condition first under same declared coverage; not a realized loss
outcome_taxonomy.TARGET_FIRST: Target condition after declared hypothetical entry condition, before stop, with ordered sufficient coverage; not a fill or realized gain
outcome_taxonomy.TIME_STOP: Full holding horizon after modeled entry condition with neither barrier observed

prohibitions: No restricted 2024+ research or FINAL_HOLDOUT reads
No new PRIMARY registration or consumption
No historical economic experiment under this mandate
No assumed OOS, profitability or Alpha
No worker dispatch, native requests, account calls, orders or alerts

risk_measurements.executable_R: NULL/UNKNOWN absent later admissible executable bid/ask, capacity, instrument units, cost/funding schedules and entry/exit evidence; candle touch is insufficient
risk_measurements.hypothetical_after_cost_R: Explicit model output under frozen fee/spread/slippage/funding/carry/jump/review-delay assumptions; keep separate from executable or realized results
risk_measurements.planned_R: Ex-ante geometric reward/risk at worst entry-region boundary and frozen structural stop/target; no fills or outcomes
risk_measurements.probability: No assumed 50% win rate for 3R/4R. Planned payoff and rule confidence are not probabilities or expected return.
risk_measurements.risk_denominator: Freeze initial adverse per-unit risk and cost projection before outcomes. Do not tighten stop or select distant target after observing outcomes to force 2R/3R/4R.
